note: #2767 item 7 (literal ">" inside a quoted HTML tag attribute value defeats the open-tag scan): isInsideOpenHtmlTag never existed under that name in this repo's git history. The closest current mechanism, matchInlineHtmlTagEnd / INLINE_HTML_OPEN_TAG_PATTERN (built for #2865), already has quoted-attribute-value state tracking that correctly consumes an embedded ">" inside quotes without ending the tag early. No defeat of the open-tag scan was reproduced (MISMATCH).
